    • dryRunCreate

      public CloudRouterJson dryRunCreate(CloudRouterCreatorJson cloudRouterCreatorJson)
      Dry-run variant of create(CloudRouterCreatorJson): POSTs the same body to /fabric/v4/routers with the spec's dryRun=true query parameter ("option to verify that API calls will succeed"). Nothing is provisioned; the spec's dry-run example (CloudRouterResponseExampleDryRun) is the validated request echoed back with no uuid/href/state.
      Specified by:
      dryRunCreate in interface CloudRouterClient<CloudRouter>
      Parameters:
      cloudRouterCreatorJson - the create request body to validate
      Returns:
      the validated request echoed back by the API
